title: Recognize hosted chat, Cursor agent and GitHub PR URL identities
body:
## Purpose
Extend the existing LibreChat/Open WebUI trace URL handling to the user-supplied hosted service URL shapes. Keep URL identity and content access explicitly separate.

## Changes
- Add stdlib-only, offline conversation_url.parse_reference() and JSON CLI for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, M365 Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor agents and GitHub PRs.
- Return provider/kind/id/canonical URL; PR IDs include repository and number. Cursor IDs remain agent IDs.
- Integrate with trace_probe while retaining the legacy self-hosted /c, /s, message and query behavior. Known hosted services do not fall back to unrelated query IDs.
- Require exact HTTPS hosts and complete routes; reject userinfo, unexpected ports, encoded separators, control/whitespace, empty/reserved IDs and extra path segments.
- Document that URL tokens are opaque, are not proof of access/existence, and do not provide private chat content. No private IDs or page contents are committed.

## Validation
46 passed across tests/test_conversation_url.py and tests/test_trace_probe.py, with JUnit generated. New parser tests block sockets, use synthetic IDs and cover all seven service/resource shapes plus malformed/unsupported inputs and legacy integration. git diff --check passes. Published tree d7b3b849772ef0e4b1ce08d816bccc1deb214924 matches the tested local index.

## Boundaries
No new network transport, authentication, MCP tool, vendor changes or dependencies. The M365 screenshot only establishes the route shape; its clipped ID was not reconstructed. Existing trace clustering still joins identical ID strings; cross-service persistence should use provider/canonical URL. resume_chat_path remains a legacy /c helper.

GitHub content retrieval is not declared complete: gh_identity.pr returns state/head/base; comments returns previews; issue explicitly rejects PRs. Reuse the existing GitHub tools/endpoints for body, comments, files and diff. #110 is an independent, unmerged source-access/HTML snapshot feature; this PR does not alter it.

No merge performed.
